mapper.select: SELECT CANDIDATE_NO AS candidateNo, REP_QUESTION AS repQuestion, CATEGORY AS category, INQUIRY_COUNT AS inquiryCount, SIMILARITY AS similarity, STATUS AS status, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM TB_FAQ_CANDIDATE WHERE STATUS = '대기' ORDER BY INQUIRY_COUNT DESC, UPDATED_AT DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_FAQ_CANDIDATE SET STATUS = #{status}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE CANDIDATE_NO = #{candidateNo}
UPDATE TB_FAQ_CANDIDATE SET STATUS = #{status}, DRAFT_ANSWER = #{answer}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE CANDIDATE_NO = #{candidateNo}
